About Jared Gibbons
Which areas of Ladner should I look at for townhomes?

Townhome pockets run through Port Guichon, Ladner Village, East Ladner, Hawthorne, Neilsen Grove and Holly. Lot sizes, how old the homes are and where prices sit all vary by pocket, which is why I line the area up with your budget and commute.
What schools serve Ladner?

These townhomes fall within Delta School District 37 (Delta Secondary, plus the elementary schools at Neilson Grove, Holly and Hawthorne). The district assigns schools by address, so before buying, ask them to verify the school for the home.
How is transit and commuting from Ladner?
The George Massey crossing is a quick drive along Hwy 17/99, and Ladner Exchange buses run to Bridgeport and on to Richmond-Brighouse via the Canada Line.
What zoning rules affect townhomes in Ladner?
Most detached lots are zoned Delta RS. East Ladner includes big farm parcels in the ALR, and across town the Bill 44 small-scale multi-unit rules take effect.
What should I check before buying a townhome in Ladner?
Strata checklist for a townhome: depreciation report, roof and envelope history, fees and parking rules. Ahead of subject removal, I review the documents with you.
Are first-time buyer exemptions available in Ladner?

Yes, if you qualify. Both the property transfer tax exemption that BC offers First-Time Home Buyers and the federal FHSA can apply. Thresholds change, so my first-time buyer guide has the current numbers.
